stories.title: Chinese tech firms’ ‘snub’ to US Congress advisers highlights growing AI caution
stories.simple_summary: Chinese technology companies are refusing to talk to American government advisers about AI, showing that both countries are becoming more cautious and protective about their AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about government politics and international relations — it doesn't directly affect ordinary people or small businesses right now.

stories.title: SpaceX vs. Nvidia: Which Trillion-Dollar Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Is the Better Buy After the Recent Pullback?
stories.simple_summary: A financial article comparing whether SpaceX or Nvidia (two big tech companies) would be a better investment choice right now.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors with money to put into stocks — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Hollywood’s open secret: It’s battling AI — but already recruiting to use it
stories.simple_summary: Movie and TV studios say they're worried about AI but are also quietly hiring it to help make their work, showing they see both the risk and the usefulness of the technology.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work in entertainment, the rules about AI in your industry are still being figured out. If not, this doesn't affect you yet.

stories.title: AI layoffs mount amid software sector bloodbath
stories.simple_summary: Many software companies are laying off workers, and many are saying AI is the reason — they're replacing some jobs with AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI is starting to replace some office and technical jobs, though mostly at large tech companies.

stories.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
stories.simple_summary: At least 20 major tech companies have announced they're laying off employees and blaming AI as a reason for the cuts.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same concern as the previous story — AI is replacing some jobs, mostly at big tech companies.

stories.title: What's the difference between closed, open‑source and open-weight AI? A researcher explains
stories.simple_summary: A researcher is explaining the differences between three types of AI: closed ones (locked and controlled by one company), open-source ones (where the code is shared), and open-weight ones (somewhere in between).
stories.why_it_matters: If you're curious about how AI works, this helps explain the different types, but it's mostly educational.

stories.title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
stories.simple_summary: Libraries are offering classes teaching people how to avoid using AI and AI-powered tools, and lots of people are signing up because they're tired of technology companies.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're not comfortable with AI and want to keep using older methods, libraries near you might have workshops to help.

stories.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
stories.simple_summary: A power line went down near an AI data center (a building full of computers that run AI), and it showed that these centers don't handle power problems very well.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters more to engineers and businesses that run data centers — they need to prepare better for power problems.

stories.title: The AI jobs apocalypse probably isn’t coming anytime soon
stories.simple_summary: Despite worries that AI will eliminate most jobs soon, experts think major job loss from AI probably won't happen in the near future.
stories.why_it_matters: This is reassuring news if you're worried about AI replacing your job — it's likely to happen slowly, not all at once.

stories.title: Silicon Valley Splits Over Closing the Borders to Chinese A.I.
stories.simple_summary: Silicon Valley tech leaders disagree on whether the U.S. should block Chinese companies from getting advanced AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This is government policy debate — it doesn't directly affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: From Silicon Valley to DC, the tech world is suddenly obsessed with one concept in AI: Distillation
stories.simple_summary: Government officials and Silicon Valley leaders are all focused on something called 'distillation' (making complicated AI smaller and simpler) as an important new direction for AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical development that engineers care about — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (an AI company) made a new tool that some computer programmers will enjoy using, but regular people probably won't understand or want to use it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a specialized tool for coders — if you're not a programmer, you don't need to worry about it.
